intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A banner hangs crooked overhead. Kaedra could straighten it without standing on her toes.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Some way off, a custodian is approaching with a ladder. Slowly. It is a very long ladder.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “I could fix it. He has been carrying that ladder since before we arrived.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “Stand here. Very still. Looking at something else.”

options.labelText: “I’ll look at something else with you.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Thank you. I recommend that wall. It has been very well built.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The custodian climbs up and straightens the banner. He climbs down looking like a man who has won something.

options.labelText: “You’re right there, though. Two seconds and it’s done.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She reaches up. The banner is straight in two seconds.

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The custodian arrives. He looks up at the banner, then lowers his ladder very slowly.
